) on Monday announced a definitive agreement to acquire the personal care division of AccentCare for an anticipated purchase price of about $275 million.
The transaction relates only to AccentCare’s personal care operations outside of New York and does not relate to its hospice and home health operations, the company said.
Addus expects to close the transaction following completion of regulatory approvals and subject to customary closing conditions.
Addus will fund the acquisition through a combination of the company’s revolver and cash on hand.

The acquisition expands Addus’ personal care service capabilities in four primary states: Texas, Illinois, California, and Arizona, while also adding operations in six additional states: Colorado, Georgia, Minnesota, Pennsylvania, Tennessee, and Washington.

title: Addus HomeCare announces agreement to acquire personal care division of AccentCare
